page.overview:
Who is Erchtei?

Erchtei was born into a highly respected family on the outer Fire Islands. Dissatisfied with a lawful life in the Fire Nation, however, he opted to become a pirate and join the Fifth Nation. This decision not only disgraced his entire family, but also greatly hurt their finances as he stole his relatives' money to kickstart a corsair career. As a powerful firebender, Erchtei rose in the ranks of the pirate nation and became a commander. He took part in the battle against Yun's forces, including Kyoshi, in 296 BG. This clash shattered the Fifth Nation and ended in Tagaka's capture, though Erchtei was able to escape with a remnant faction of corsairs.

After a period of time, Erchtei and other Fifth Nation loyalists were contacted by Tagaka who had broken out of prison and tried to restore their grand fleet. Though her previous defeat had destroyed Erchtei's faith in the pirate queen, he joined her forces as he lacked the charisma to convince his followers to stay independent. Thus, he became the new second-in-command of Tagaka's fleet, though harbored the hope of eventually getting the chance to seize power himself.

Seeking ways to loot resources and money to rebuild the Fifth Nation, Tagaka agreed to Erchtei's plan to attack Jasmine Island. Unlike his superior, Erchtei had bigger ambitions for the location: He wanted to not just plunder, but to rule the island. Erchtei envisioned himself as a governor on behalf of the Fifth Nation. Accordingly, he hoped to reach some kind of accord with the locals to ease the takeover. As the pirates approached Jasmine Island, they chanced upon a Fire Nation warship and captured it. In the process, they kidnapped inventor Tei Eesoni; neither Tagaka nor Erchtei recognized Tei's true value, instead forcibly conscripting her as an "engineer" to aid with the captured warship's engines.

Upon arriving at Jasmine Island, the pirate fleet was attacked by a small Fire Nation ship commanded by famous firebender Hei-Ran. As this clash was still ongoing, Erchtei opted to already launch an initial small attack on Jasmine Island to exploit the element of surprise. Despite Mirlon's intel, Erchtei's knowledge of the locals was quite limited. Thus, his initial attack was more of scouting mission; the pirate commander also used the opportunity to talk with a group of protectors, including Ara, Joh, Fu Karaq, Revik, and Yarru, trying to convince them to surrender. Instead, the natives fought off the first landing.
